examples.text: avantiyā kho, gahapati, āgacchāmī'ti. atthi, bhante, avantiyā isidatto nāma kulaputto amhākaṃ adiṭṭhasahāyo pabbajito? diṭṭho so āyasmatā'ti?

10305.commentary: (THa) bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā pabbājetha maṃ, bhante'ti āha. tena vuttaṃ avandi coro sugatassa pāde, tatth'eva pabbajjam'ayāci buddhan'ti.

examples.text: icc'eva coro asim'āvudhañ'ca, sobbhe papāte narake anvakāsi, avandi coro sugatassa pāde, tatth'eva pabbajjam'ayāci buddhaṃ.

10311.synonym: aveti, ājānāti, paccabyati, pajānāti, bujjhati, munāti, vedeti

examples.text: sutvā dhanañ'jāniṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etadavoca, avabhūtā'va ayaṃ dhanañ'jānī brāhmaṇī, parabhūtā'va ayaṃ dhanañ'jānī brāhmaṇī, vijjamānānaṃ tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ, atha ca pana tassa muṇḍakassa samaṇakassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissatī'i.

10322.meaning1: bad luck; ill omen; inauspicious sight

examples.text: vuccate, ayaṃ kira brāhmaṇo maṅgalakiccesu samaṇadassanaṃ avamaṅgalan'ti evaṃdiṭṭhiko, tato mahābrahmuno bhuñjanavelāya kāḷakaṇṇī muṇḍakasamaṇako mama nivesanaṃ upasaṅkamatīti mantvā cittaṃ nappasādesi, añña'd'atthu dosavasaṃ'y'eva agamāsi.

siveyyakaṃ nāma uttarakurūsu sivathikaṃ avamaṅgalavatthaṃ. tattha kira manussā mataṃ tena vatthena veṭhetvā nikkhipanti, taṃ maṃsapesī'ti sallakkhetvā hatthisoṇḍakasakuṇā ukkhipitvā himavantakūṭe ṭhapetvā vatthaṃ apanetvā khādanti.
mā-avamaññetha puññassa, na man'taṃ āgamissati, udabindunipātena, udakumbho'pi pūrati, dhīro pūrati puññassa, thokaṃ thokam'pi ācinaṃ.

jayaṃ veran'ti jitaṃ mayā'ti parisamajjhe parassa sāṭakaṃ vā veṭhanaṃ vā gaṇhāti, so parisamajjhe me avamānaṃ karosi, hotu, sikkhāpessāmi nan'ti tattha veraṃ bandhati, evaṃ jinanto sayaṃ veraṃ pasavati.

10365.meaning1: something for the purpose of scraping off

examples.text: akukkuccakajātan'ti bhaveyya nu kho, na bhaveyyā'ti ajanetabbakukkuccaṃ. lekhaṇiyā likheyyā'ti avalekhanamattakena avalikheyya. dhoveyyā'ti ghaṃseyya.

10366.commentary: (MNa) add'āvalepanā upakāriyo'ti c'ettha manussā pākārapādaṃ assakhurasaṇṭhānena iṭṭhakāhi cinitvā upari sudhāya limpanti. evaṃ katā pākārapādā upakāriyo'ti vuccanti. tā tintena kalalena sittā add'āvalepanā nāma honti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, adda-avalepanā upakāriyo pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi, icchām'ahaṃ, samma rattapāṇi, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pīta-avalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rajitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti.

10370.meaning1: looking at; looking back; examining; checking
10370.commentary: (MNa) avalokayamānā'ti sirasmiṃ añjaliṃ ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ olokentāva paccosakkitvā dassanavijahanaṭṭhāne vanditvā gacchanti.

examples.text: te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamanti avalokayamānā'y'eva avijahitattā.

10372.meaning1: powerless; without control; without free will
10372.commentary: (MNa) avasā abalā avīriyā'ti tesaṃ attano vaso vā balaṃ vā vīriyaṃ vā n'atthi.

examples.text: yaññ'atthaṃ vā dhan'atthaṃ vā, ye hanāma mayaṃ pure, avase taṃ bhayaṃ hoti, vedhanti vilapanti ca.

n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.

10373.meaning2: having thrown down; having put on or into; having hung on; having suspended

examples.text: taṃ, kiṃ maññasi māṇava, idh'assa puriso naḷakāragāme jātavaddho, tam'enaṃ naḷakāragāmato tāva'd'eva avasaṭaṃ naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puccheyyuṃ,
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
atha kho bhagavā kapilavatthusmiṃ yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi tadavasari.

10378.meaning2: no control; no authority; no power over

10382.meaning2: not wielding power; without control; having no authority (over)
10382.commentary: (THIa) citte avasavattinī'ti vīriyasamatāya abhāvena mama bhāvanācitte na vasavattinī. sā kira ativiya paggahitavīriyā ahosi. (THIa) ahosiṃ uddhatā pubbe, citte avasavattinī'ti pubbe mama citte mayhaṃ vase avattamāne uddhatā nān'ārammaṇe vikkhittacittā asamāhitā ahosiṃ.

examples.text: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, aladdhā cetaso santiṃ, citte avasavattinī, tassā me aṭṭhamī ratti, yato taṇhā samūhatā.
usulomavatthusmiṃ kāraṇiko'ti rāj'āparādhike anekāhi kāraṇāhi pīḷetvā avasāne kaṇḍena vijjhitvā māraṇakapuriso. so kira amukasmiṃ padese viddho maratī'ti ñatvā'va vijjhati.

10387.commentary: (THIa) avasāyī'ti avasāyo vuccati avasānaṃ niṭṭhānaṃ, tam'pi kāmesu appaṭibaddhacittatāya uddhaṃsotā'ti vakkhamānattā samaṇakiccassa niṭṭhānaṃ veditabbaṃ, na yassa kassaci, tasmā padadvayenā'pi appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā'ti ayam'attho vutto hoti.

examples.text: chandajātā avasāyī, manasā ca phuṭā siyā, kāmesu appaṭibaddhacittā, uddhaṃsotā'ti vuccatī'ti.

10388.commentary: (THa) vihāre ca sah'āvasin'ti na kevalaṃ tassa bhagavato dassanam'eva mayā laddhaṃ, atha kho vihāre satthu gandhakuṭiyaṃ satthārā kāraṇaṃ sallakkhetvā vāsentena saha avasiṃ.

examples.text: upasampadā ca me laddhā, vimutto c'amhi anāsavo, so ca me bhagavā diṭṭho, vihāre ca saha-avasiṃ.
mah'esīnaṃ pasādenā'ti paccekabuddhamah'esīnaṃ pasādena. paccekajinaseṭṭhesu, dhutarāgesu tādisū'ti lokadhammehi niccalesu paccekabuddhesu padmakesaraṃ padumareṇuṃ okiriṃ avasiñcin'ti sambandho.

dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.
siyā c'assa uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāya
yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddhā-avasittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, aggivessana, vatteyya rañño khattiyassa muddhā-avasittassa sakasmiṃ vijite vaso, ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ, jāpetāyaṃ vā jāpetuṃ, pabbājetāyaṃ vā pabbājetuṃ, seyyathā'pi rañño pasenadissa kosalassa

ath'āparaṃ viññāṇaṃ'y'eva avasissati parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ. tena ca viññāṇena kiṃ vijānāti? sukhan'ti'pi vijānāti, dukkhan'ti'pi vijānāti, adukkham'asukhan'ti'pi vijānāti.
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakka-avasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāv'ādhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.
ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi, āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissi.

10396.commentary: (NIDD1a) avasissatū'ti tiṭṭhatu. upasussatu maṃsalohitan'ti sabbaṃ maṃsañ'ca lohitañ'ca sukkhatu.

examples.text: saddhassa, bhikkhave, sāvakassa satthusāsane pariyogāhiya vattato ayam'anudhammo hoti, kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre avasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

akammaṃ h'etaṃ, mahārāja, jinaputtānaṃ yadidaṃ pūjā, sammasanaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ, yoniso manasikāro, satipaṭṭhān'ānupassanā, ārammaṇasāraggāho, kilesayuddhaṃ, sadattham'anuyuñjanā, etaṃ jinaputtānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, avasesānaṃ devamanussānaṃ pūjā karaṇīyā.
guṇavantānañ'hi guṇaṃ buddhā eva pākaṭaṃ kātuṃ sakkonti, avasesajano guṇavantānaṃ guṇaṃ kathento maccharāyati
